capabilities: Sync Wispr Flow meeting notes into the vault as Markdown notes with wispr_id frontmatter
Write companion transcript files alongside or inside meeting notes
Schedule automatic syncing on an interval or run manual and full re-syncs
Filter meetings by date range, title keyword, and finalization status
Configure destination folders, subfolder layouts, and filename patterns
disambiguation: Not a vault or device sync tool; 'sync' here means copying Wispr Flow meeting data from local app storage into the vault.
extras: Desktop-only and macOS-supported (the Windows path is implemented but untested); works with Wispr Flow's free tier; the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README includes extensive disclosures on file, vault, clipboard, network, and telemetry access, and documents known limitations such as unbounded debug log growth and a possible schema break from future Wispr Flow updates.
problem: Wispr Flow's Notetaker stores meeting notes and transcripts only inside its own application data folder with no local API, so there is no built-in way to get them into an Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: reads meeting notes and transcripts that Wispr Flow's desktop app has already recorded locally

summary: Wispr Flow integration that reads locally recorded meeting notes and transcripts from Wispr Flow's app data and writes them into the vault as Markdown.
